scope: Preserve and validate task and movement evidence across immutable closures, completion events, backup restore, and concurrent uploads.
changes: Backup validation now resolves evidence subjects across live state, person-month closures, and company closures.
Task and movement snapshots validate their evidence ID lists; every archived evidence reference must resolve to matching metadata and a file in v2 backups.
Evidence metadata can remain valid when its task or movement exists only in an archived closure; orphaned snapshot references are rejected before restore.
Evidence attached to a task is linked to the timestamp when that task is newly completed; activity attachments and existing completion links remain unchanged.
The IndexedDB upgrade adds a record-scope index; per-record file limits are checked in the same read-write transaction as writes, preventing concurrent upload races.
Version 2 backup files carry task and activity identity, and restore repopulates the indexed record scope. Older version 2 backups without these optional fields remain valid.
